mode.label: What to copy
prompt.start.title: Paste it into your coding agent
prompt.start.body: Open the agent in the repository you want to set up, with at least one commit and no uncommitted changes. Any agent that can run commands works.
prompt.apply.title: The agent adopts the setup
prompt.apply.body: It chooses a version and profile and reviews the proposed changes. Then it installs the source's files, adapts your project's own content and runs the source's checks.
prompt.review.title: You review and commit
prompt.review.body: Nothing is committed for you. Review the changes, including any file the source replaced, then commit as usual. To update later, give the agent the same prompt again.
terminal.start.title: Run it in your repository
terminal.start.body: In the repository you want to set up, with at least one commit and no uncommitted changes, using Node.js 24 or 26.
terminal.apply.title: Answer its questions
terminal.apply.body: It asks for a version and profile and shows the proposed changes. Then it installs the source's files, walks you through adapting your own content and runs the source's checks.
terminal.review.title: Review and commit
terminal.review.body: Nothing is committed for you. Review the changes, including any file the source replaced, then commit as usual. Run the same command again later to update.
